brian-head.detail: The resort's own site lists lift tickets starting at $9 on select dates; kids 12 and under ski free.
brian-head.label: From $9

brighton.detail: Winter lift tickets (all-day / afternoon / night) shown from $72 on the official tickets page.
brighton.label: From $72

granite-peak.detail: The official tickets page's Early Bird Sale lists adult tickets starting at $67/day for 2026/27; rates run across four season periods and vary with purchase timing.
granite-peak.label: From $67

jay-peak.detail: Adult window day tickets on the official 2026/27 rates page: $125 midweek, $145 weekends, $149 holidays; advance online purchase is $20 less.

lake-louise.detail: Adult full-day tickets on the official lift-tickets page run CA$60 to CA$185 depending on date; the low end is early-season pricing.
lake-louise.label: CA$60–CA$185

monarch-mountain.detail: Adult full-day window rates on the official tickets page: $119 low, $149 standard, $179 peak; online prices are dynamic.

powder-mountain.detail: All-day tickets on the official lift-tickets page are listed at $63–$229 per day; date-based pricing and daily ticket sales are capped.

saddleback.detail: The official lift-tickets page publishes 2026/27 day-of walk-up (window) pricing: adult (ages 19-64) 1-day $140; online advance tickets are dynamically priced lower.

snowbird.detail: Adult full-day lift tickets; the official tickets page states full-day prices starting at $195 and its own product data gives the range 195 to 239 USD.

sugar-bowl.detail: The resort's online store lists discounted advance-purchase lift tickets starting at $89; tickets are dynamically priced.
sugar-bowl.label: From $89

sundance.detail: The official tickets page lists the 2026/27 adult full-day ticket (ages 13+) at $169.

whitefish-mountain.detail: The official lift-tickets page lists the adult (ages 19–64) 1-day ticket at $120; buying online 48+ hours ahead saves 10%.
